subject.title: feat(memory-lancedb): scope memory_recall and memory_forget + configurable thresholds

question: Should the bundled `memory-lancedb` plugin adopt a second caller-defined multi-scope contract and three new recall settings, or should advanced scope isolation remain in the existing external plugin until trusted session-derived scoping is designed?
rationale: The code can implement either direction, but repository policy cannot determine whether OpenClaw should permanently duplicate the external plugin's scope semantics or expose model-supplied partition keys in a bundled memory plugin.

options.title: Keep External Scope Canonical
options.body: Direct advanced multi-scope users to `memory-lancedb-pro` and avoid adding a parallel bundled contract until a missing plugin API is demonstrated.

options.title: Sponsor Bundled Scoping
options.body: Approve bundled scope support after defining its trusted identity semantics, rollback guarantees, and complete live proof requirements.

options.title: Narrow To Thresholds
options.body: Split the independent recall-threshold configuration into a smaller PR while the scope model remains under product review.

recommendation.title: Keep External Scope Canonical
recommendation.body: Direct advanced multi-scope users to `memory-lancedb-pro` and avoid adding a parallel bundled contract until a missing plugin API is demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release ownership and prior memory-lancedb review history make this the strongest available routing candidate for bundled-plugin product scope.
